summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Tabletop Lounge Platform Foundation. 7/7 pytest cases pass (health, players CRUD, sessions CRUD, settings persistence). All required frontend flows verified via Playwright: Lounge landing, Game Library (filters + search), Game Detail for Valora (launch) and Lexicon Hall (wishlist / no engine), Game Host Frame chrome + leave, Players view (add/save/persist/delete), Sessions view (new session -> /play/valora, delete), Settings (theme switch reflected on html[data-theme], reload persistence). Plugin registry only wires Valora + Lexicon Hall with engine=null; no Lexicon Hall gameplay code present.

minor.issue: SessionUpdate model does not expose the 'turn' field, so clients cannot advance turn through the update endpoint (silently ignored). Session model itself has turn=0 default. Add 'turn: Optional[int] = None' to SessionUpdate.

issues: React Router v6 future flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) spam the console. Non-blocking but noisy; add future flags to <BrowserRouter>.

action_items: Add 'turn: Optional[int] = None' to SessionUpdate pydantic model in /app/backend/server.py so clients can persist turn changes for game surfaces.
Optional: pass future={v7_startTransition:true, v7_relativeSplatPath:true} to React Router to silence console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly separates platform-core from game-specific concerns (no game imports); good.
SessionUpdate omits 'turn' field despite Session.turn existing -- inconsistent update surface.
clean() strips _id correctly on every fetch path; no ObjectId leaks.
Settings uses upsert with _key sentinel -- correct pattern for singleton settings doc.
Contract validation (validateGameModule) throws on hard errors; Lexicon Hall correctly registered as COMING_SOON with engine=null and no Surface as spec dictates.
CORS middleware added AFTER include_router; still works with FastAPI but by convention middleware should be attached before including routers.
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed TEST_ cleaned up in each test cycle. One UI-created player (TEST_UI_Player) was created and deleted during the Playwright run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend + platform foundation shell fully functional. Only outstanding backend gap is 'turn' not being updatable via PUT /api/sessions/{id}. All data-testid selectors work correctly; no missing test hooks. Settings persist across reload including data-theme attribute on <html>. Delete confirmations use window.confirm dialogs so tests must auto-accept.
